init(address).details: Exists to seal the cyclic dependency between this contract and the host when the host is not known at construction; a manager constructed with its host set needs no `init`. Only the admin may call it, and only once: the admin is the governance relayer key, and letting it re-point the host later would let that key cut the host off from its own governance.
